newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica set to expel Australian child-sex suspect.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica set to expel Australian child-sex suspect.

text.p: A South African high court rejected a suspected Australian paedophile's appeal against extradition on Wednesday, leaving him just one more legal chance to avoid repatriation.
The court in the university town of Grahamstown rejected Philip Bell's appeal not to be sent home to face 215 sex offences relating to boys aged 10 to 18.
The 62-year-old was arrested in the south-coast surfing mecca of Jeffreys Bay in January.

Bell's lawyer Neil Paterson told the court he had been instructed to challenge its decision in South Africa's highest court, the Appeal Court in the judicial capital Bloemfontein, where the case will be heard from Friday.
